anomalies.description: Three men inside a moving van are engaged in mutual physical combat: one man in an orange jacket is striking another man in a green jacket, while a third man in blue restrains or attacks the man in green; visible punches and grappling occur.

A white van collides with the side of a larger white truck on a highway; visible impact and deformation at contact point.; A white van collides with the side of a larger white Isuzu truck; visible impact deformation on the van's front-right fender and the truck's side panel, with contact occurring between frames f0–f3.
Inside the van, the man in green jacket is being physically restrained and struck by the other two men; hands are raised in aggressive gestures, and body positions indicate active struggle.

A renewed physical altercation inside the van: multiple occupants (including those in pink, green, and blue jackets) are seen flailing arms, grabbing, and pushing each other violently; one person is thrown backward against the window.; Three men inside a van are engaged in a physical struggle: one in orange raises arms defensively, one in green is grabbed and restrained by the others, and one in blue actively participates in subduing the central figure.
A white van collides with a larger truck on a highway; the van's front end is visibly crumpled upon impact.
The struggle continues with the man in green being held down and restrained by the other two; he appears to be resisting while they attempt to control him.
